About LUMA

A place where you belong.

LUMA Laser and Electrolysis is an inclusive, professional studio offering laser hair removal and electrolysis, where every body is treated with care, expertise, and respect. We believe smooth, confident skin should be accessible to everyone — regardless of skin tone, identity, or background.

Founded with the belief that clinical shouldn't mean cold, we've created a space that feels as welcoming as it is results-driven.
